decisions.statement: This repository has one master instance.
Every copy other than the master is a backup or read-only.
A type declaration is the one thing imported from another repository.
No file here imports a file in another repository.
This repository contains no unused code.
Domain logic lives in a package of its own domain.
No command that calls domain logic is named inside domain logic.
Every third-party package this repo uses is declared.

definition: the repository nothing tracked is outside

directives.name: Atomic Commit
directives.act: Stage and commit in one command, naming the paths that commit is for.
directives.warrant: A parent's worktree is shared by every child, so anything staged and not committed is swept up.
aids: Never reach for `-a` to make it one command.
Name the files, never a directory that may grow.

directives.name: Right Version
directives.act: Check a claim about a file against the version it was made about, not the one on disk now.
directives.warrant: A file has no time, so the wrong version answers as confidently as the right one.
aids: Treat a small unexplained gap as the file moving.
